textPrompt: Create an exceptionally beautiful, luxurious, fully responsive automotive portfolio website titled "APEX MOTORS — Where Performance Meets Prestige." Showcase an exclusive collection of the world's most desirable luxury, sports, and exotic cars. The website must deliver a breathtaking digital experience that immediately captures visitors' attention. Design a world-class automotive website inspired by prestigious luxury car brands. Use an exceptionally attractive, harmonious color scheme, sophisticated typography, cinematic photography, elegant spacing, premium visual effects, and creative layouts. Every section should feel polished, modern, immersive, and visually extraordinary. Create a spectacular full-width hero section featuring a stunning luxury supercar photographed from a dramatic angle, with a compelling headline and an elegant "Explore Collection" button. Include a premium showroom featuring Ferrari, Lamborghini, Porsche, Rolls-Royce, Bentley, Mercedes-Benz, and BMW. Display beautiful vehicle cards with relevant photographs, model names, and accurate specifications where available. Add sections for featured supercars, luxury SUVs, executive sedans, electric performance vehicles, automotive innovations, and exclusive collections. Include an immersive gallery showcasing vehicle exteriors, luxurious interiors, distinctive headlights, dashboards, and exquisite automotive details. Incorporate elegant navigation, captivating image galleries, sophisticated hover effects, smooth transitions, attractive calls to action, and a professional contact section. Ensure flawless mobile responsiveness, excellent readability, strong visual hierarchy, and consistent branding. Every photograph must match its corresponding vehicle. Avoid unrelated images, broken assets, generic templates, repetitive layouts, unattractive colors, and excessive text. Present vehicle listings as illustrative examples without inventing actual inventory, prices, or availability. The final website must resemble an award-winning international luxury automotive showroom, delivering the sophistication, beauty, and visual excellence expected of a premium automotive brand.
